$comment: Exact pin of the contract package consumed by the platform service (task 1.2, CS-04 consumer case). The digest is the SHA-256 of the exact wheel installed (also recorded in uv.lock, which uv verifies on install). 1.1.0 (change add-research-universe-and-daily-loop) is a backward-compatible minor of the first stable release 1.0.0 (contracts D16; the compatibility gate against 1.0.0 passes as a minor without the 0.x exemption): it may be deployed to beta, gamma and prod. Until the contract registry exists (tooling stack re-run by the bootstrap, then the build stage's publish step) the wheel is built reproducibly from contracts/python (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=315532800) and vendored; the vendored pin stays the build input after publication, and the publish step refuses a registry asset whose SHA-256 differs from this digest.
source: contracts/python (built locally and vendored; published to CodeArtifact by the build stage once the registry exists)
registry: CodeArtifact via /finplan/shared/financialplanning/contract/registry-ref (pending the tooling bootstrap re-run)
